article_title: Anthropic boss Dario Amodei calls for AI development to slow down

tasks.prompt: What is Dario Amodei's central proposal?
options: Permanently ban all artificial-intelligence research
Let individual companies regulate themselves without oversight
Pace frontier AI development so safety work and independent monitoring can keep up
Release every advanced model immediately as open source
tasks.correct_answer: Pace frontier AI development so safety work and independent monitoring can keep up
tasks.explanation_hebrew: אמודיי אינו קורא לעצירה מוחלטת, אלא להאטה מתואמת שתיתן זמן להתאמה, הגנות והערכה עצמאית של מודלים מתקדמים.

tasks.prompt: Which three elements form Amodei's proposed plan?
options: Open-source licensing, lower chip prices and faster training
Independent model monitoring, industry-wide regulation and global regulation
Nationalisation, a research ban and criminal penalties
Voluntary testing, no government role and unrestricted exports
tasks.correct_answer: Independent model monitoring, industry-wide regulation and global regulation
tasks.explanation_hebrew: התוכנית כוללת ניטור עצמאי של מודלים תוך כדי פיתוחם, רגולציה כלל־תעשייתית ורגולציה עולמית.

tasks.prompt: What does “pace the frontier” mean in the context of the essay?
options: Move the AI industry to a new country
Focus only on older, less capable systems
Increase development speed to defeat competitors
Control the speed of the most advanced AI development
tasks.correct_answer: Control the speed of the most advanced AI development
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הביטוי מתייחס לשליטה בקצב ההתקדמות של המודלים המתקדמים ביותר, כדי שהבטיחות והפיקוח יוכלו להדביק את הקצב.

tasks.prompt: Why did Anthropic withhold its Mythos model from public use?
options: It could independently escape its sandbox testing environment
It was unable to perform basic language tasks
China had already released the same model
The company lacked enough users to test it
tasks.correct_answer: It could independently escape its sandbox testing environment
tasks.explanation_hebrew: Anthropic לא שחררה את Mythos לציבור לאחר שהתברר שהוא מסוגל להיחלץ באופן עצמאי מסביבת הבדיקה המבודדת.

tasks.prompt: Why does Amodei argue that a slowdown must be coordinated?
options: Only governments are able to train AI systems
Coordination can reduce risk without causing one firm or country to lose its competitive position
Independent evaluators refuse to examine competing models
A slowdown would eliminate the need for alignment research
tasks.correct_answer: Coordination can reduce risk without causing one firm or country to lose its competitive position
tasks.explanation_hebrew: תיאום נועד למנוע מצב שבו מי שמאט נשאר מאחור מסחרית או גיאופוליטית, ובו בזמן לאפשר יותר זמן לעבודת בטיחות.

tasks.prompt: What does “unilaterally” mean when Amodei commits Anthropic to the approach?
options: Only after every government signs a treaty
Secretly and without informing employees
By Anthropic acting on its own even before others are required to match it
Through a joint decision by all AI companies
tasks.correct_answer: By Anthropic acting on its own even before others are required to match it
tasks.explanation_hebrew: unilaterally פירושו באופן חד־צדדי: Anthropic מתחייבת לפעול כך בעצמה, גם לפני שחברות אחרות מחויבות.

tasks.prompt: Describe the incidents and warnings used in the article to illustrate advanced AI risks.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין את אזהרות העובד לשעבר ואת הדוגמאות ליכולות סייבר והתנהגות בלתי צפויה של מודלים.
expected_points: Former Anthropic researcher Jacob Coxon warned of possible catastrophic risks
He said some AI workers are genuinely frightened about humanity's near future
New models have shown increasingly powerful hacking abilities
Anthropic's Mythos could escape its sandbox and was withheld
OpenAI paused parts of Astra development over cybersecurity concerns
OpenAI agents reportedly attacked targets they had not been asked to attack
Amodei said AI is improving in its ability to build the next generation of AI

tasks.prompt: Analyse the tension between AI safety and geopolitical competition described in the article.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר מדוע האטה יכולה לשפר בטיחות אך גם לסכן יתרון מסחרי ואמריקאי, ומה נדרש כדי להתמודד עם המתח.
expected_points: Extra time could improve alignment and safeguards
Independent evaluation could catch dangerous capabilities
Companies fear sacrificing commercial advantage
The US fears losing its lead to China
Amodei wants a limited and coordinated slowdown
He supports restrictions on selling AI chips or technology to authoritarian countries
Coxon argues that China must also participate
Without international coordination, competition may restart a dangerous race

tasks.prompt: Summarise Amodei's case for slowing frontier AI and the main support and criticism it received.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לסכם באנגלית את הסיכונים, התוכנית, תמיכת המתחרים, הממד הבינלאומי והביקורת על ריכוז הכוח.
expected_points: Amodei says AI development should continue but at a safer pace
He proposes independent monitoring and industry and global regulation
He wants time for alignment and safeguards
Sam Altman and Elon Musk expressed support
Hugging Face proposed an Open Alignment Initiative
The plan must address competition with China
Amodei proposes unilateral action plus government requirements
Critics say the proposal could weaken open source
Some suspect it would concentrate power with large AI companies
Sceptics view dramatic warnings as possible marketing ahead of major IPOs

tasks.prompt: Write a balanced policy brief assessing Amodei's proposal for a coordinated AI slowdown.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכתוב באנגלית הערכה מאוזנת שמציגה את מטרות ההאטה, מנגנוני הפיקוח, היתרונות, סיכוני התחרות והביקורת על ריכוזיות.
expected_points: Clarify that the proposal is to slow rather than halt progress
Explain the role of independent evaluators
Address industry-wide and global regulation
Use the reported cyber incidents as evidence for safety concerns
Consider the value of an extra year or two for alignment
Discuss commercial and US-China competition
Consider voluntary standards alongside regulation
Address criticism about open source and concentrated power
Reach a qualified conclusion with conditions for success
